distinguishing_features: Active variable-stiffness tuned mass damper that changes damper stiffness in response to measured flow rather than passively monitoring a natural-frequency decline.
Use of existing flow rate and pressure telemetry to compute vortex shedding frequency and a lock-in band for a pipeline span.
Control objective of suppressing flow-excited fatigue strain by maintaining separation between structural or damper resonance and shedding frequency across changing flow.
Application to subsea pipeline VIV with a piezoelectric stiffness actuator and no new flow or pressure sensors.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to reduce fatigue strain in a flow-excited subsea pipeline span when the excitation frequency varies with flow and can coincide with a structural resonance.

parsed.non_obvious_reason: Using an existing flow signal to retune a known variable-stiffness TMD for a flow-dependent excitation frequency is a predictable application of standard VIV and TMD control principles.
